title: Stalk of the pullback of a module, and germs of pulled-back sections
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, with $f^\sharp_x:\mathcal O_{Y,f(x)}\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$ the induced map of local rings, and let $\mathcal G$ be an $\mathcal O_Y$-module with pullback $f^*\mathcal G$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. For an open $V\subseteq Y$ and $s\in\mathcal G(V)$ write $f^*s\in(f^*\mathcal G)(f^{-1}V)$ for the image of $s$ under the unit $\mathcal G\to f_*f^*\mathcal G$ of the adjunction $f^*\dashv f_*$. Then for every $x\in X$, with $y=f(x)$, there is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules
$$(f^*\mathcal G)_x\;\cong\;\mathcal G_y\otimes_{\mathcal O_{Y,y}}\mathcal O_{X,x}$$
(the tensor product formed with $f^\sharp_x$), natural in $\mathcal G$, under which the germ $(f^*s)_x$ of $f^*s$ (for $V\ni y$, $s\in\mathcal G(V)$) corresponds to $s_y\otimes1$.

source.place: Sheaves, Lemma 6.26.4 (Tag 0098, label lemma-stalk-pullback-modules), proof via Lemma Tag 008B (lemma-stalk-tensor-sheaf-modules) and the stalks of $f^{-1}$; the description of the germs of $f^*s$ is part of the construction of the isomorphism (the stalk of the unit $\mathcal G\to f_*f^*\mathcal G$ at $y$ composed with $(f_*f^*\mathcal G)_y\to(f^*\mathcal G)_x$)
